# Raed Shafeek (رائد شفيق) — Raed Codes

> Raed Shafeek is a Senior Software Engineer at Sager Drone and a freelance AI engineer based in Amman, Jordan, with 6+ years of experience building secure, scalable platforms. He is the founder and sole developer of CarTech, a car inspection platform, and was a founding full-stack engineer at Vamu for over three years. He shares practical engineering tips in Arabic on Instagram as "Raed Codes" (@raedcodes). Also known as Raed AbuJaib / Raed Shafeek AbuJaib.

## Expertise
- AI engineering: LLM apps and integration, AI agents and automation, RAG, AI architecture consulting (freelance since 2024)
- Full stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, NestJS, FastAPI, Python, PostgreSQL
- Blockchain: Hyperledger Fabric (Certified Hyperledger Expert, Certified Hyperledger Developer, Certified Blockchain & Supply Chain Professional)
- Security & compliance: GRC platforms for SAMA and ISO 27001 (ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Lead Implementer training)

## Selected work
- CarTech — B2C car inspection platform; founder & sole developer
- Unleash AI Mentor Platform — solo-built AI mentorship app: https://ai.unleashnow.io
- GRC cybersecurity compliance platform — at Vamu
- Service provider for Orange Corners Jordan and Endeavor Jordan startups
